role_profiles.title: Associate – AI Web Engineer / Full-Stack Associate
about: Build and maintain reliable web applications across the frontend and backend.
Work with the team to deliver accessible, tested features and clear technical documentation.

responsibility_groups.heading: Full-Stack Web Development
bullets: Build and maintain frontend and backend features.
Connect user interfaces to application services and APIs.

responsibility_groups.heading: Quality and Reliability
bullets: Write and maintain tests for assigned work.
Investigate defects and document their cause and resolution.

responsibility_groups.heading: AI Feature Integration
bullets: Integrate approved AI capabilities into product workflows.
Check outputs for usability, safety, and consistency with product requirements.

responsibility_groups.heading: Collaboration and Delivery
bullets: Break work into trackable tasks and communicate progress.
Review feedback and maintain concise technical documentation.

offer_responsibilities: Full-stack development: deliver assigned frontend and backend features.
Quality: test changes and resolve defects.
AI integration: implement approved AI-enabled workflows.
Team delivery: report progress, blockers, and completed work.
role_profiles.contract_duties: The Associate will design, build, test, document, and maintain full-stack web application features; integrate approved AI capabilities into product workflows; investigate and resolve defects; and coordinate delivery with the team. Duties are limited to the responsibilities in this Role Profile and reasonable related work assigned by the manager.
work_setup: Remote or hybrid setup as agreed with the manager
Reliable internet and a quiet workspace
Use approved company accounts and systems
performance_structure: Progress is reviewed against the eight KPI areas below.
The manager provides regular feedback and records agreed actions.
Success measures are reviewed at the end of the assessment period.

kpi_areas.title: Delivery
bullets: Complete planned work within agreed timelines.
kpi_areas.success: Agreed tasks are completed on time or risks are raised early.

kpi_areas.title: Code Quality
bullets: Follow project conventions and keep changes maintainable.
kpi_areas.success: Changes are reviewed with no recurring avoidable quality issues.

kpi_areas.title: Testing
bullets: Add or update relevant automated and manual checks.
kpi_areas.success: Work passes agreed checks and includes evidence of verification.

kpi_areas.title: Reliability
bullets: Investigate defects and communicate incidents promptly.
kpi_areas.success: Issues are documented, triaged, and resolved within agreed priorities.

kpi_areas.title: AI Feature Quality
bullets: Use approved AI services and validate feature behavior.
kpi_areas.success: AI-enabled work meets the stated requirements and is checked for unsuitable output.

kpi_areas.title: Communication
bullets: Share clear progress, decisions, and blockers.
kpi_areas.success: The manager and teammates can understand status and next steps.

kpi_areas.title: Collaboration
bullets: Participate in reviews and respond constructively to feedback.
kpi_areas.success: Feedback is addressed and handoffs are complete.

kpi_areas.title: Documentation and Security
bullets: Maintain useful technical notes and follow information-handling rules.
kpi_areas.success: Work is documented and company information remains in approved systems.
